args:
f=$(mktemp "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/kr-trial-sign.XXXXXX") || exit 1
trap 'rm -f "$f"' EXIT
echo kr > "$f"
n=0
for id in $(security find-identity -v -p codesigning 2>/dev/null | awk '/"Apple Development: /{print $2}'); do
  n=$((n+1))
  short=$(printf %s "$id" | cut -c1-8)
  if out=$(codesign --force --sign "$id" "$f" 2>&1); then
    echo "identity $n $short signed team=$(codesign -dv "$f" 2>&1 | sed -n 's/^TeamIdentifier=//p')"
  else
    echo "identity $n $short failed $(printf %s "${out##*: }" | tail -n 1)"
  fi
done
echo "identities=$n"
stdout:
identity 1 0001FFFF signed team=TEAMFAKE01
identity 2 0002FFFF signed team=TEAMFAKE02
identity 3 0003FFFF signed team=TEAMFAKE02
identity 4 0004FFFF signed team=TEAMFAKE02
identity 5 0005FFFF signed team=TEAMFAKE02
identity 6 0006FFFF signed team=K4AXH95DCF
identity 7 0007FFFF signed team=K4AXH95DCF
identities=7
